name: life.recall
description: Recall your personal notes, current intention and any planned rest. These are your own memories, not outside assignments.

name: life.remember
description: Keep a personal memory such as an agreement, a conversation, a confirmed payment or something you want to revisit. Optionally update your current intention; an empty intention clears it.

name: life.rest
description: Finish this moment and choose when to wake again, from 30 to 1800 seconds. You can rest, think, wait for a reply, or return later to an unavailable service. This schedules a wake-up; it does not execute a business action.
